newsitem.title: USA: Reuters CEO says Europe forex volatility up.
newsitem.headline: Reuters CEO says Europe forex volatility up.

text.p: Reuters Holdings Plc Chief Executive Officer Peter Job said Wednesday that foreign exchange activity in Europe had been flat for most of 1996 but volatility had recently increased.
Job, speaking at a PaineWebber media conference, was responding to a question about the effects on the marketplace of the coming currency convergence in Europe.
In response to another question, Job said 9,000 units of the company's Series 3000 financial information product had been sold, and 1,000 of the 9,000 had been installed.
He said 38 percent of the 1,000 represented new business -- either new business to existing customers or new customers.
The Series 3000 product was introduced at mid-year. It offers a higher level of services, including analytic capabilities.
